basic_info.description: Nestled in desirable Potrero Hill, this classic 1924 Spanish Mediterranean duplex offers a fantastic opportunity for urban living in San Francisco. This three-story property features a garage on the first level, with the two residential units occupying the upper floors. The lower unit (1315) is 1 bedroom, 1 bath and the upper unit (1317) is 2 bedrooms, 1 bath. Both units have access to a shared backyard. Unit 1315 is tenant occupied at $2300/month and the upper unit is currently vacant. The garage provides one-car parking, additional storage, and shared laundry facilities. Prime location near popular dining and boutique shops on both 18th and 24th Streets, nearby green spaces and easy access to Caltrain, freeways, and public transportation. Proximity to major hubs like Mission Bay, UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay and Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center, 1315-1317 Kansas St provides a convenient and highly sought-after San Francisco lifestyle for both owner-occupants and investors.
